e.title: transitionMatrix (Python)
e.summary: 状态转移矩阵统计分析库（Open Risk，88★）：信用评级迁移/多状态系统，多种估计器+可视化
e.body: transitionMatrix（Open Risk，88★，Apache-2.0）是 Python 状态转移现象统计分析库：从带时间戳的历史事件数据估计转移矩阵（多种估计器）、转移矩阵运算（生成元/比较）、事件数据与转移矩阵可视化，附标准化测试数据集。典型场景：信用评级迁移、多状态系统事件日志。对 RIAA：多状态建模与信用转移分析——与 [[credit-risk]]（概念）、[[ifrs9-ecl]]（IFRS 9 减值模型）配套；多状态视角可与 [[stochastic-reserving-england]] 等随机方法对照。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：Open Risk 状态转移矩阵库（多估计器+可视化+测试数据），88★
e.summary_en: State-transition-matrix statistical analysis library (Open Risk, 88★): credit-rating migrations / multi-state systems, multiple estimators + visualisation
e.summary_hk: 狀態轉移矩陣統計分析庫（Open Risk，88★）：信用評級遷移/多狀態系統，多種估計器+可視化
e.body_en: transitionMatrix (Open Risk, 88★, Apache-2.0) is a Python library for the statistical analysis of state-transition phenomena: it estimates transition matrices from timestamped historical event data (a variety of estimators), manipulates transition matrices (generators, comparisons), visualises event data and transition matrices, and ships standardised test datasets. Typical use cases: credit-rating migrations and multi-state system event logs. For RIAA: multi-state modelling and credit-transition analysis — pairs with [[credit-risk]] (the concept) and [[ifrs9-ecl]] (IFRS 9 impairment); the multi-state angle can be compared with stochastic approaches such as [[stochastic-reserving-england]].
e.body_hk: transitionMatrix（Open Risk，88★，Apache-2.0）是 Python 狀態轉移現象統計分析庫：從帶時間戳的歷史事件數據估計轉移矩陣（多種估計器）、轉移矩陣運算（生成元/比較）、事件數據與轉移矩陣可視化，附標準化測試數據集。典型場景：信用評級遷移、多狀態系統事件日誌。對 RIAA：多狀態建模與信用轉移分析——與 [[credit-risk]]（概念）、[[ifrs9-ecl]]（IFRS 9 減值模型）配套；多狀態視角可與 [[stochastic-reserving-england]] 等隨機方法對照。
